code_commit_note: isu_conditions.py and snl_cycles.py were first committed in e48bc2d (swept in by the P0 commit); final state in the commit named in commit.txt

snl_per_cycle_definitions.q_dis_ah: max of cumulative discharge_capacity_in_Ah within the cycle record
snl_per_cycle_definitions.throughput_ah: trapezoid integral of |current_in_A| over time_in_s, divided by 3600
snl_per_cycle_definitions.t_start_s/t_end_s: seconds since the first sample of the cell
snl_per_cycle_definitions.retention_vs_first: q_dis_ah / q_dis_ah of the cell's first cycle

duplicate_test: 5 raw-record fingerprints per cell (SHA-1 of rounded V and I at cycles 1, 2, 100, middle, last) compared across all 1830 pairs; per-cycle capacity vectors compared over common cycles (exact and median |dq| < 1e-4 Ah)
